controls: No packet contains a ResearchRef or QuestionRef.
Both packets target a role, not a technology/service endpoint.
Suggested scope is narrower than the originating MajorRegion.
Owner-boundary constraints and negative discriminants are carried forward.
Atlas evidence remains routing evidence only.
Downstream rejection/split/defer is legal and does not change Atlas coverage.

findings.claim: Atlas can hand off proposal-review evidence without minting ResearchRef, QuestionRef, semantic owner or Foundation.
Technology-neutral targetIntakeRole is sufficient for shared routing; no MCP/service/repository/database endpoint belongs in the semantic envelope.
Physical and Cosmology candidate packets preserve different scope/discriminants despite originating from neighboring zero-touch owner-gap diagnostics.
The handoff boundary lets Atlas remain a map/frontier system while Research System retains authority over Question/Charter/Investigation admission.
